content:
**Overly Generous** is a Charisma-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Melee and unarmed attacks have a chance to inflict rads on an enemy, chance increases at higher rads.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Rads increase your chance to inflict 50 Rads with melee attacks! | 00006F8D | 
| ★ | 1 | Rads increase your chance to inflict 25 Rads with melee attacks! | 00006DC1 |
